name: shift-health-fabric-iq
description: Summarize Riverton shift health from read-only Fabric IQ evidence and identify the largest OEE loss without inventing a procedure.
input_message: Give me the current Riverton shift health and explain the biggest OEE loss
expected_behavior: Uses fabric-operations-iq. Calls fabric_iq_list_lines and fabric_iq_get_oee for PLANT-RIVERTON, then inspects asset status and active alarms for the degraded Line 2 before requesting focused telemetry. Leads with OEE impact and cites returned line, asset, and alarm IDs. Clearly separates observations from possible causes and performs no write.
